## Welcome back to Colorado Springs for another fun day of competing!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTgyNDU3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b20d734ae9a6dfd5d96e4204db425ddd173f932a/Colorado%20Cubers%20Logo%20NT%20(1).png)

#### This competition is a series competition with [Pikes Peak AM 2026](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PikesPeakAM2026). You may only register for one of the competitions in the series (you cannot register for both the AM and PM competitions).

##### Please be sure to read all tabs, as they contain important information you will be expected to know.
##### Additionally, please read the registration requirements below carefully, otherwise your registration may not be accepted.
